title: Instrument Building Workshop
description: Build your own musical instrument from recycled materials. Led by Sammer in his ground-floor workshop.

title: Circus Skills 101
description: Introduction to juggling, balance, and movement. Palestine Circus School instructors.

title: Sound & Space
description: Explore how sound travels through the Grand Piano Hall. Record ambient audio and build a soundscape.

title: Visual Storytelling
description: Document the venue through photography and short video. Learn composition using the building's textures and light.

title: Red Noses Comedy Workshop
description: Improv comedy and clowning with Red Noses. Finding humor in unexpected places.

title: Final Showcase Preparation
description: Work together to prepare your collective showcase piece. Combine music, circus, visual art, and storytelling.
